atkinson-hyperlegible-next.role: Everything: band, signs, boards, desk, replica, foot. SIL OFL; embedded latin WOFF2 (tools/agent_portal/fonts/AtkinsonHyperlegibleNext-latin-wght.woff2), variable weight 200-800, font-display: block; user-approved 2026-10-16.

rootScale.purpose: Everything is in rem off this root; the 13px floor is .8125rem.

figures.purpose: Counts, rule ids and dates align.

departmentInk.purpose: Text in a department colour (a step's module, a board's step label).

shadows.name: band
shadows.purpose: The sign band over the floor.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: The desk and the board standing off the wall.

shadows.name: sign-lit
shadows.purpose: A passed or shut stage sign.

shadows.name: rings
shadows.value: pin 0 0 0 2px #e8a400; pressed step 0 0 0 1px var(--dc); pressed replica button 0 0 0 3px color-mix(var(--dc) 22%); ask focus 0 0 0 3px rgba(232, 164, 0, .45)

motion.name: land
motion.value: later() timer table + land(): clears every pending timer and runs it now, finishes every finite animation
motion.purpose: A new turn, a badge change or Space lands what was playing; in a tour Space also moves to the next turn.

motion.name: walk
motion.value: changed signs apply one after another, 190ms apart; each settles from scale(.97) in 220ms; colours transition .22s
motion.purpose: The route lights in the order the engine decided.

motion.name: arrow-draw
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) -> inset(0 0 0 0) on the next li's ::before, 180ms
motion.purpose: The arrow into a sign is drawn when the sign before it passes.

motion.name: pending
motion.value: board and replica opacity .45 (.15s) during the walk; then repainted from the new state
motion.purpose: The board and replica go quiet while the route walks.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: opacity 0, translateY(4px) -> none, 220ms; board lines 60ms apart; no overshoot
motion.purpose: Messages on the desk and the board's lines.

motion.name: replica
motion.value: page fade 200ms; pin opacity + translateX(6px) 240ms at +140ms; pressed-button halo 0 -> 3px, 280ms ease-out at +200ms, once
motion.purpose: The step's screen, its pin and its button.

motion.name: tour
motion.value: types at 26ms a character, waits 380ms, asks; 1800ms after an answer, 1500ms otherwise; steps walked 1700ms apart; Space skips, Esc stops

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all animation and transition off; timers fire at once; tour waits capped at 300ms

motion.name: at-rest
motion.purpose: Motion explains a decision and stops.

motion.name: keys
motion.value: / to type, 1 2 3 a badge, T a tour, Space lands what is moving (in a tour, the next turn), Esc to stop it

geometry.name: sign
geometry.value: height 3.75rem (3.375rem short; auto, min 2.75rem on a phone); status -webkit-line-clamp 2 (1 on a phone)
geometry.purpose: Signs never resize as answers change.

geometry.name: board-h
geometry.value: --board-h: 12.5rem; 12rem at max-height 760px; overflow-y auto as a fallback only
geometry.purpose: One route geometry per screen size, measured over every task and probe at 1280/1366/1440/1600/1920.

narrative.overview:
The HIS Staff Assistant shows a request as a route through the hospital's own screens. The visitor puts on a staff badge (Reception, Nurse, Administrator) and asks at the enquiry desk in their own words, or plays that badge's tour. The request then walks five fixed stage signs: Enquiry (understood, from which words), Staff only (the DPDP check for this badge, before any detail is asked), Details (each one shape-checked), Department (the modules the steps need) and Screen (each step placed on the screen where it happens). Under the signs, the active stage's board, and under that a replica of the hospital's portal that lights the column and the button the step uses. It refuses the chatbot with a side panel and the node-graph "AI pipeline".

The world is hospital wayfinding signage. The ground is a pale cool corridor wall (Wall). Signs are navy panels set in white Atkinson Hyperlegible Next. The five HIS modules are departments, each with its own colour on a square pictogram tile, drawn in one stroked family; arrows are drawn too. State colours are earned: red for the staff-only door when it stays shut, green for a check passed, amber for "you are here". Signs hold fixed positions and only their state changes. The answer on the desk is a set of step signs in their departments' colours. Each pairs with the replica screen that proves where it happens. The replica is the hospital's portal, not ours: a grey chrome bar, tabs, a page with the module's buttons and columns, and blank ruled rows. No patient value appears anywhere.

The standing bar holds: **elegant and professional.** The system keeps it as restraint. There is no decorative gradient, no glass and no side stripe. A shadow appears only where a sign stands off the wall. Motion is short and explains a decision, then stops: signs light in order, an arrow is drawn into the next sign, the board and replica repaint from the new state. Density is presentation density for the presenting laptop (1366x768). The desk scrolls; the route holds one geometry per screen size, and the presenter explains.
keyCharacteristics: A pale corridor wall, a navy sign band, an enquiry desk (about 42%) beside the route (about 58%).
Five stage signs in fixed positions, joined by drawn arrows; only their state changes (waiting, current, passed, stopped, unknown).
Five department colours on square pictogram tiles, one drawn and stroked family, never glyphs.
Red only for the staff-only door when it stays shut; green only for a check passed; amber for "you are here".
Every step on the desk pairs with a replica of the hospital's screen, its column and button lit, with no patient value shown.
Atkinson Hyperlegible Next throughout, embedded; 13px floor.
A new turn lands what is playing; reduced motion lands every state at once.

rules.name: The Earned State Rule
rules.body: Red means the staff-only door stayed shut, green means a check passed, amber means "you are here". None of the three marks anything else.

rules.name: The Department Colour Rule
rules.body: A department colour belongs to its module. It appears wherever a step goes to that module (tile, step number, replica tab, column, button), never as decoration. The Department sign takes its module's colour only once passed.

rules.name: The Their Screen Rule
rules.body: The replica keeps the hospital portal's own greys. Our navy appears on it only as the pin.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next sets everything, the replica included. No second face and no monospace.

rules.name: The 13px Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing read is set below 0.8125rem of a root that is never below 16px (`clamp(16px, 0.6vw + 8px, 19px)`).

rules.name: The Off The Wall Rule
rules.body: A shadow appears only where a sign stands off the wall: the band, the panels, a lit stage sign, the pressed badge. No decorative gradient, no glass, no side stripe.

dos: **Do** show every request as a route through five fixed stage signs; change only their state.
**Do** keep red for the staff-only door when it stays shut, green for a check passed, amber for "you are here".
**Do** give each HIS module its department colour, and use it only where a step goes to that module.
**Do** pair every step with the replica screen that proves where it happens, its column and button lit and the pin inline on the title line.
**Do** keep the route's geometry fixed: signs 3.75rem with the status clamped to two lines, the board at `--board-h` (12.5rem; 12rem at ≤760px viewport height).
**Do** draw every pictogram and arrow in the one stroked family on square tiles.
**Do** set everything in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, embedded, at or above the 13px floor.
**Do** call `land()` before a new turn, and land every state at once under reduced motion.
**Do** keep the file single and offline.
donts: **Don't** show a patient value: the replica's rows stay blank and say "No patient data is shown here."
**Don't** use green for a department; Clinical is teal because green means a check passed.
**Don't** say "crawler", "Python" or a URL path in staff-facing text.
**Don't** let the signs, board or replica resize as answers change.
**Don't** add a decorative gradient, glass, a side stripe, or a shadow on anything that is not a sign standing off the wall.
**Don't** use glyphs or an icon font for pictograms or arrows.
**Don't** overshoot or bounce; rises are 220ms and the press halo grows once.
**Don't** turn the page into a chatbot with a side panel or a node-graph pipeline.
principles: Elegant and professional (the standing bar): no decorative gradient, glass or side stripe; motion that explains a decision and then stops.
